meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 将旧版 NanoClaw 与 Claude 记忆迁移到共享记忆树：先暂存再分类，整理成核心记忆与概念文件，更新索引，生成迁移报告供确认。迁移过程会暂停相关任务序列。
howto.when: 当更新后报告共享记忆有破坏性变更，或群组仍存在 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等旧版记忆文件时触发；也可直接用「migrate memory」「legacy memory」等指令唤起。

say.text: 把旧的 CLAUDE.md 和 .seed.md 迁移到新的记忆树里吧
say.note: Claude 会先列出受影响群组并请求批准。

say.text: 升级后它好像把记忆全忘了，帮我迁移一下
say.note: 这会触发记忆迁移流程，先暂停相关任务。

say.text: 清理一下旧版记忆文件，迁移到共享记忆
say.note: Claude 会开始暂存、整理并生成报告。

howto.what_en: Migrates legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree: stages files, then classifies them into core memory and concept files, updates indexes, and produces a migration report for approval. Pauses related task series during the process.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has legacy memory files such as .seed.md, CLAUDE.md, etc. Can also be invoked with phrases like "migrate memory" or "legacy memory".

say_en.text: Migrate the old CLAUDE.md and .seed.md into the new memory tree, please.
say_en.note: It will list affected groups and ask for approval first.

say_en.text: It seems to have forgotten everything after the upgrade; can you migrate the memory?
say_en.note: This triggers the migration workflow, pausing relevant tasks first.

say_en.text: Clean up legacy memory files and migrate them to shared memory.
say_en.note: It will stage, organize, and produce a report.
